morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入后作为独立词根使用；to- 不是前缀。ber- + toko → bertoko，词首 t 保留，无鼻音同化。

word_family.gloss: 在店铺售卖商品；经营店铺
书店；由两个词组成的名词短语

senses.en_definition: A shop or store where merchandise is sold.
senses.nuances: 马来语规范词，但在马来西亚一般日常交流中 kedai 更常见。toko 常见于书店、店名及区域性表达；在印度尼西亚语中使用范围更广。不要与 tokoh“人物”或 tauke“老板”混淆。[DBP 释义及搭配](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=toko)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Penganjur mengundang penerbit dan pengusaha toko buku untuk menyertai pesta buku tersebut.
dual_scenarios.zh: 主办方邀请出版社及书店经营者参加该书展。
dual_scenarios.en: The organisers invited publishers and bookshop operators to participate in the book fair.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku nak singgah toko buku tu kejap, cari novel je.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya mahu singgah sebentar di toko buku itu untuk mencari novel sahaja.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我想去那家书店逛一下，就找本小说。
dual_scenarios.en: I want to pop into that bookshop for a moment, just to look for a novel.
spoken_features: toko buku 可自然用于已知店铺，日常也常说 kedai buku

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kau dah pergi toko buku kat hujung jalan tu?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah kamu sudah pergi ke toko buku di hujung jalan itu?
messages.zh: 你去过街尾那家书店了吗？
messages.en: Have you been to that bookshop at the end of the road?

messages.speaker: Daniel (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Belum lagi. Nak pergi petang ni? Aku nak cari novel je.
messages.ms_standard: Belum. Mahukah kamu pergi petang ini? Saya hanya mahu mencari novel.
messages.zh: 还没呢。今天下午一起去吗？我就想找本小说。
messages.en: Not yet. Want to go this afternoon? I just want to look for a novel.

etymology.historical_story: Toko is commonly traced to Hokkien thó͘-khò͘, written 土庫, a warehouse term. Research on these buildings links the name to storage and maritime trading communities. In Malay, toko denotes a shop. Its history offers a concrete image of commercial vocabulary travelling with merchants, connecting the storage of goods with places where goods are sold. [Historical research](https://freeleaf.tw/2021/10/05/toko-a-local-concept-that-traveled-the-world-eng/) [Etymological reference](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/toko)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: to-ko 联想闽南语“土库”：先想到存货的仓库，再想到卖货的店铺；toko buku 就是卖书的店。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: toko 是中性场所名，没有贬义。向店员询问时可说 Maaf, ada buku ini?；称呼对方时不应仅凭族群或年龄猜用 tauke。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 在马来西亚，普通购物对话用 kedai 通常更自然；toko buku、既有店名或区域性表达则可保留 toko。该词不专指华人经营的商店。
